name: How long does a property injury lawsuit take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a property injury lawsuit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a property injury lawsuit can vary significantly based on several factors, including the complexity of the case, the severity of injuries, the willingness of parties to negotiate, and court availability. Some cases settle quickly through negotiation, while others may proceed to trial, which can take a year or more. A lawyer can provide a more accurate timeline after evaluating the specifics of your claim, but most cases aim for a fair settlement outside of court.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of a property injury lawsuit varies, from quick settlements to over a year for trials, depending on case complexity and negotiation.
